"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from triangle_mesh import *


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, M, x):
        rhs = M.ElementSets()
        self.V = rhs[0]
        self.E = rhs[1]
        self.F = rhs[2]
        dimv_0 = M.n_vertices()
        dime_0 = M.n_edges()
        dimf_0 = M.n_faces()
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        dim_0 = x.shape[0]
        assert x.shape == (dim_0, 3, )

        self.M = M
        self.x = x
        _Neighborhoods = self.Neighborhoods(M)
        self.Faces = _Neighborhoods.Faces
        self.Faces_0 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_0
        self.Faces_1 = _Neighborhoods.Faces_1
        self.VertexOneRing = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing
        self.VertexOneRing_0 = _Neighborhoods.VertexOneRing_0
        self.OrientedOppositeFaces = _Neighborhoods.OrientedOppositeFaces
        self.OppositeVertices = _Neighborhoods.OppositeVertices
        self.OppositeVertices_0 = _Neighborhoods.OppositeVertices_0
        self.NeighborVerticesInFace = _Neighborhoods.NeighborVerticesInFace
        self.OrientedVertices = _Neighborhoods.OrientedVertices
        self.OrientedVertices_0 = _Neighborhoods.OrientedVertices_0
        pass

    def VertexNormal(self, i):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert i in self.V

        sum_0 = np.zeros((3, ))
        for f in self.Faces_0(i):
                rhs_1 = self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, i)
            j = rhs_1[0]
            k = rhs_1[1]
            sum_0 += (np.cross((self.x[j] - self.x[i]), (self.x[k] - self.x[i]))) / ((np.power(np.asarray(np.linalg.norm(self.x[j] - self.x[i], 2), dtype=np.float64), 2) * np.power(np.asarray(np.linalg.norm(self.x[k] - self.x[i], 2), dtype=np.float64), 2)))
        return (sum_0)

    def θ(self, i, f):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert f in self.F

        rhs_2 = self.NeighborVerticesInFace(f, i)
        j = rhs_2[0]
        k = rhs_2[1]
        return np.arccos((np.dot(((self.x[j] - self.x[i])).ravel(), ((self.x[k] - self.x[i])).ravel())) / ((np.linalg.norm(self.x[j] - self.x[i], 2) * np.linalg.norm(self.x[k] - self.x[i], 2))))

    def area(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        rhs_3 = self.OrientedVertices(f)
        i = rhs_3[0]
        j = rhs_3[1]
        k = rhs_3[2]
        return (1/2) * np.linalg.norm(np.cross((self.x[j] - self.x[i]), (self.x[k] - self.x[i])), 2)

    def N(self, f):
        assert np.ndim(f) == 0
        assert f in self.F

        rhs_4 = self.OrientedVertices(f)
        i = rhs_4[0]
        j = rhs_4[1]
        k = rhs_4[2]
        return ((np.cross((self.x[j] - self.x[i]), (self.x[k] - self.x[i])))) / ((2 * self.area(f)))

    def l(self, i, j):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V

        return np.linalg.norm(self.x[j] - self.x[i], 2)

    def ϕ(self, i, j):
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V

        # e = (x_j-x_i)/‖x_j-x_i‖
        e = ((self.x[j] - self.x[i])) / (np.linalg.norm(self.x[j] - self.x[i], 2))

        rhs_5 = self.OrientedOppositeFaces(i, j)
        f_1 = rhs_5[0]
        f_2 = rhs_5[1]

        # `n_1` = N(`f_1`)
        n_1 = self.N(f_1)

        # `n_2` = N(`f_2`)
        n_2 = self.N(f_2)
        return np.arctan2(np.dot((e).ravel(), ((np.cross(n_1, n_2))).ravel()), np.dot((n_1).ravel(), (n_2).ravel()))

    def cot(self, k, j, i):
        assert np.ndim(k) == 0
        assert np.ndim(j) == 0
        assert np.ndim(i) == 0
        assert i in self.V
        assert j in self.V
        assert k in self.V

        rhs_6 = self.OrientedVertices_0(k, j, i)
        oj = rhs_6[0]
        oi = rhs_6[1]

        # cos = (x_oj - x_k)⋅(x_oi-x_k)
